result.note: V16 layer-streamed GPU KV staging uses two alternating one-layer buffers; pinned CPU staging remains per step. FP32 predictor, selected indices, recent-20, carry and attention match V12. Async predicts and packs the next step during current decode; next-step H2D begins at its decode boundary. dma_ms spans all layer transfers and compute gaps, so it is not pure DMA service time.
